now.title: Loki S2#1
now.text: Ouroboros, the TVA's repair technician, once shared a friendly bond with Mobius, who nicknamed him O.B., but Mobius forgets him over the centuries. When they meet again, O.B. happily reminisces while Mobius pretends to remember, and the two work together to save the Temporal Loom.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Mobius nicknamed O.B., then forgot. Helps him save the Loom.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who forgot Ouroboros and pretends otherwise. Together they save the Loom.

proposed.text: Ouroboros, the TVA's repair technician, once shared a friendly bond with Mobius, who nicknamed him O.B., but Mobius forgets him over the centuries. When they meet again, O.B. happily reminisces while Mobius pretends to remember, and O.B. sends Mobius out to the Temporal Loom to pull Loki out of time.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Mobius nicknamed O.B., then forgot. Helps him pull Loki out of time.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who forgot Ouroboros and pretends otherwise. Goes out to the Loom to pull Loki free.

changes.evidence: In 'Ouroboros' (S2E1) O.B. has Mobius approach the overloading Temporal Loom with the Temporal Aura Extractor to pull the time-slipping Loki out, then seals the Loom off with the blast doors; nothing saves the Loom here. The Loom is never saved at all: it explodes in 'Heart of the TVA' (S2E4) and Loki destroys it in 'Glorious Purpose' (S2E6), so the text and both card lines ('save the Loom') are false.

now.title: Loki S2#2
now.text: Hunter X-5 brushes Mobius off at the TVA, then deserts and hides on the Sacred Timeline as the actor Brad Wolfe. Mobius tracks him down on the red carpet at his premiere and pesters him about a sequel before Loki blocks his escape.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The TVA analyst who tracks X-5 down on the red carpet after the desertion.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Deserting Hunter Mobius tracks down, hiding on Earth as the actor Brad Wolfe.

proposed.text: Mobius tracks Hunter X-5 down on the red carpet in 1977, where the deserter lives as the actor Brad Wolfe, and pesters him about a sequel before Loki blocks his escape. In holding, X-5 taunts Mobius for never looking into his own life before the TVA until Mobius slaps him.

changes.evidence: X-5 brushing Mobius off at the TVA (the jet ski photos before the War Room meeting) happens in 'Ouroboros' (S2E1), not this stage's 'Breaking Brad' (S2E2). In S2E2 Mobius corners Wolfe at the premiere asking about a sequel, Wolfe pins him to a wall fleeing, and in holding Wolfe mocks him for not knowing who he was a variant of until Mobius slaps him.

now.title: Loki S1#5
now.text: Mobius hunts Sylvie as the TVA's most dangerous variant and captures her on Lamentis-1. After he learns the TVA's lies and is pruned, he picks her up in the Void and backs her plan to enchant Alioth.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The variant Mobius hunts and captures, then helps against Alioth.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The agent who captures Sylvie, then backs her plan to enchant Alioth.

proposed.text: In the Void, Mobius pulls Sylvie away from Alioth, apologizes for what the TVA did to her as a child and backs her plan to enchant the creature. She gives him her TemPad so he can go back and expose the TVA.

changes.evidence: The current text sums up earlier episodes: the hunt for the Variant and the Lamentis-1 capture are 'The Variant' (S1E2) and 'The Nexus Event' (S1E4), and Mobius is pruned in S1E4. In 'Journey into Mystery' (S1E5) Mobius rescues Sylvie from Alioth in his car, apologizes for the TVA's treatment of her childhood, sides with her plan over Loki's, and leaves for the TVA with the TemPad she gives him.

owner_calls.question: With the S1E5 stage fixed to its own events, should the earlier hunt and capture get its own enemy stage (Mobius hunts the Variant and has her brought in from Lamentis-1 in 'The Nexus Event', S1E4)?
options: Add an enemy stage at Loki S1#4
Leave the connection starting at Loki S1#5
owner_calls.evidence: In S1E4 Mobius sends Timedoors to Lamentis-1 and the TVA takes Loki and Sylvie in; in S1E2 Sylvie ambushes the TVA team Mobius leads in 2050 Alabama.
